title: Cameron Sharp Went Viral Singing to His 96-Year-Old Grandparents
tagline: Going viral, hard work, and the song he didn't expect to be a moment.
description: In May 2026, Cameron Sharp filmed himself singing one song to his 96-year-old grandparents. The video hit 2 million views. Lukas Graham commented. Crowded House shared it. A long conversation about hard work, mental health, Tamworth at 14, and the stories he hasn't told publicly.
highlights: Coldplay's Yellow at Forbes Town Hall — age 10
John Mayer "No Such Thing" live in studio

title: I Never Planned to Be a Politician
tagline: An unscripted street conversation with the local MP who never planned any of it.
description: No studio, no script — just a plastic table on the street in Grenfell. Steph Cooke, the Member for Cootamundra, sits down for a completely unscripted chat: the 4:35am starts, the by-election she didn't expect to win, and what it takes to serve 177 towns across an area the size of Switzerland.
highlights: The 4:35am starts and life on the road
Winning the by-election she didn't expect to win
Serving 177 towns across an electorate the size of Switzerland
What the job actually looks like away from the headlines

title: The 23-Year-Old Who Sees Through Everything
tagline: Money, discipline, jealousy, and what it actually costs to get there.
description: A long, unfiltered sit-down with Cayden Ryan — 23, working the mines. Real money and the work behind it, jealousy in a small town, faith, discipline, and the honest conversations no one his age is having.
highlights: From Maccas to a BMW M5 at 23
A million seconds vs a billion seconds
Are you actually happy — or just too busy to notice?

title: The Prime Minister's Pilot
tagline: A career in the air force, and the man trusted to fly the country's leader.
description: A career military pilot who flew Australia's Prime Minister. The training, the trust, the near-misses, and the stories from the cockpit.
